description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
Both copies of Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve one Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
The other Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 7.
